pages.title: Grand Warbell
pages.text: Place a $(l:raidborn:utility_and_items/grand_warbell)Grand Warbell$(/l), then right-click it to assign nearby recruited Illagers to the settlement.

pages.title: Settlement Members
pages.text: Assigned Illagers stop following you and no longer use active recruitment slots. They remain around the bell, wander, use beds, claim workstations, sleep, and follow a daily routine.

pages.title: Trading and Recruiting
pages.text: Most settlement Illagers can trade after claiming the correct workstation. You can recruit them again later when you need them in your patrol.$(br2)Beasts cannot be assigned to Settlement Mode.

pages.title: Breaking the Bell
pages.text: The Grand Warbell is the settlement center. Breaking it removes Settlement Mode from linked Illagers in the surrounding area.
